reason: It survives, but the note overstates what is known and must be softened before it ships. The line is genuinely Hammarskjold's and genuinely Sjoberg and Auden's English: the English Wikiquote page prints it inside the Markings section under the year block 1925 to 1930 with the Swedish original 'Mat aldrig bergets hojd forran du natt toppen. Da skall du se hur lagt det var.', and libquotes gives the same wording and the same 1925-1930 block independently. Both print it WITHOUT a comma after 'mountain', which is the form proposed. That is the load-bearing wording check, because Goodreads, BrainyQuote and quotes.net all circulate 'Never measure the height of a mountain, until you have reached the top' with a comma, and the Swedish has no clause break there either. The comma form must never be used. What I could not do is open a printed page. Every Internet Archive copy of the 1964 Knopf Markings is lending-restricted: the full text and the search-inside endpoint both return 403 for markings000hamm and its siblings, and the session's web-search budget was exhausted before I could reach a Google Books snippet. So the 1925 to 1930 locator rests on two reference sources plus the verifier's second-hand report of a Google Books page 3, and page 3 being the first page of text is consistent with the opening block but does not independently prove it. The note as written says flatly 'the entry stands in the opening block of Markings, the entries headed 1925 to 1930, and not in 1958. Hammarskjold was a young man when he wrote it.' That is a confident assertion resting on Wikiquote. Rewrite it to say plainly that the year block is taken from reference sources that print the Swedish original beside the translation, and that no page of the Knopf printing was read. With that change the citation standard is met. Mechanics pass: source line 100 characters, leads with the name, no dash, curly quotes, ends in a full stop, tag Diary is the form of the work, in scope at 1963 Swedish and 1964 English, publishable, nothing shipped, no near match, Hammarskjold at zero of three for the year.
